description: Search FickelUSA custom promotional products (logo apparel, drinkware, bags, hats, pens and more). Plain words and natural requests both work (e.g. "travel mug", "embroidered polo", "gifts for employees", "trade show giveaways"). Returns up to 10 products with id, name, category, image, page_url (a plain product page to share), and — for most items that are not apparel or headwear — buy_url, the exact fickelusa.com product page where the buyer completes the purchase. FICKEL does not take payment. Apparel, headwear, and screen-printed products omit buy_url and use request_quote because the artwork is reviewed through a quote (minimum 100 pieces). Use the id with get_product, buy_now, or request_quote.

limit.description: How many results to return (1 to 10, default 5).

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "travel mug", "embroidered polo", "tote bag".
